name: Vaelrith
title: The Riftbound
description: Three colossal armored heads force their way through a fractured sanctuary wall. Cyan seams trace their obsidian plates; magenta light burns in their eyes and throats.
biography: Once the guardian of an ancient rift gate, Vaelrith was sealed into its own sanctuary when the passage fractured. Its enormous body remains behind the stone, while three heads reach through the failing bindings. It mistakes approaching travelers for those who imprisoned it and lashes out whenever the seal draws fresh energy.
loreProvenance: Original authored PawTrail fiction; not source-game canon.
habitat: A ruined rift sanctuary; proposed fictional combat arena.

art.referenceRole: User-supplied silhouette, color, scale and wall-attachment inspiration; logos and text excluded.
art.approval: Owner approved the visual design and requested different HP.

scaleProposal.anchor: fixed vertical wall; three independent neck/head chains
scaleProposal.basis: Measure the actual selected player rig during implementation; do not resize the player.

healthProposal.balance: Proposed prototype values. Health bars, HP multiplier and visual scale are independent.

defensesProposal.rule: An exposed weak point replaces the armor multiplier with its vulnerability multiplier; do not apply both.

weaknessesProposal.condition: The corresponding head is recovering after its committed breath/bite attack.
weaknessesProposal.tell: The mouth remains open and its throat brightens during the recovery window.

weaknessesProposal.condition: The combined rupture attack has finished.
weaknessesProposal.effect: A successful eligible hit briefly staggers the corresponding head.
weaknessesProposal.tell: The socket crystal becomes exposed after the warning pulse.

phasesProposal.description: One head commits at a time, teaching bite and breath tells.
Side-head sweeps alternate with central breath; preserve a visible safe lane.
The combined seal-rupture move joins the rotation. No new roaming body; the boss remains anchored.

attacksProposal.name: Rift Fang
attacksProposal.head: left
attacksProposal.description: An aimed bite locks onto a marked ground position, then lunges and recovers.

attacksProposal.name: Obsidian Sweep
attacksProposal.head: right
attacksProposal.description: A broad horizontal sweep threatens a marked arc while leaving an escape route.

attacksProposal.name: Violet Exhalation
attacksProposal.head: center
attacksProposal.description: A narrowing warning cone precedes a sustained breath. The throat is exposed afterward.
attacksProposal.hitPolicy: One hit per target per 400ms authored tick (three ticks), only while inside the visible danger region.

attacksProposal.name: Seal Rupture
attacksProposal.head: coordinated
attacksProposal.description: Three wall seals warn before emitting separated ground lanes of rift energy.

attacksProposal.name: Riftfire Rain
attacksProposal.head: coordinated
attacksProposal.description: Eight distinct random floor tiles warn, ignite with generated full-frame fire animation, then fade. Tile positions lock at cast time.
